secrets.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Discord Bot Token from Discord Developer Portal (https://discord.com/developers/applications -> Bot -> Reset Token). Required for the bot to start.

secrets.name: GUILD_ID
secrets.description: Discord Server ID for instant slash command sync during development (optional).

secrets.name: SPOTIPY_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Spotify API Client ID for Spotify download support (optional, from https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard).

secrets.name: SPOTIPY_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Spotify API Client Secret for Spotify download support (optional, from https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard).
